reviewMethod: Claude Code blind review of real documents, followed by APR comparison

cases.cause: The blind review reads a complete identity and valid tax code from 07-supporting.pdf page 2, while APR rejects the form/invoice corpus. The batch contains no photographic identity document and has address/name inconsistencies in payment evidence, so the identity source must be accepted or rejected explicitly before retiring the blocker.
cases.missingDocumentType: signed customer form or accepted authoritative identity source
cases.operatorQuestion: Conferma se il documento 07-supporting.pdf pagina 2 può essere usato come fonte autorevole dell’identità; in caso contrario inserisci il modulo cliente completo e firmato o un documento d’identità leggibile.
cases.onboardingGap: identity authority and accepted document type are not explicit

cases.cause: The blind review reads the complete identity and valid tax code from 02-supporting.pdf page 5.
